title: Kirtan Mela Day - 2 Sri Dham Mayapur - March 12, 2022
description:
In the light of the severe humanitarian crisis that is being brought by the current war in Ukraine we want to dedicate Kirtan Mela 2022 to pray to our merciful Lords Sri Sri Radha Madhava, Sri Panca Tattwa and Lord Nrisimhadev for protection of their devotees affected by this war, for protecting their lives and their Krishna Consciousness, and give them all the hope and support we can. We also want to use this event to render some practical service. Please find the link in the description of this live stream and under each individual video from Kirtan Mela 2022 that will give you all the information of how you can help. 

It's https://www.shareyour.care
